altText: AI-generated fashion editorial of four adult women smiling together in a warm stone courtyard beside desert dunes. A seated woman in an ivory mini dress clasps hands with a woman leaning forward in a copper embroidered mini. A blonde woman behind her rests an arm around her shoulder, while the fourth woman leans in from the right. Two wear red-and-green crescent-and-star flag dresses. Ivory sandals, rainbow boots, copper platform boots and dark pumps vary across the group.
